blocks.prompt: 6. Differentiate with respect to the variable involved: \(y = \sec x + 4\sqrt{x} - 10\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh aasaan sawal hai: teen terms ka jama/farq, aur har term ka derivative humein maloom hai.
Diya kya hai? \(y = \sec x + 4\sqrt{x} - 10\). Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Rule kaunsa? Sum/difference rule, constant multiple rule aur power rule.
Plan: \(\sqrt{x}\) ko \(x^{1/2}\) likhenge, har term ka derivative alag lenge, aur constant 10 ka derivative 0 hoga.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \sec x + 4\sqrt{x} - 10\), \(x > 0\).
Maloom karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: term by term derivative. \(x > 0\) isliye ke \(\sqrt{x}\) ka derivative \(x = 0\) par nahi banta.

Har term alag
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{d}{dx}(\sec x) + 4\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{1/2}) - \dfrac{d}{dx}(10)\]
Kyun: sum aur difference rule se har term alag ho gayi. 4 ek constant multiple hai, woh bahar hi rehta hai. \(\sqrt{x}\) ko \(x^{1/2}\) likha taa ke power rule lag sake.

Har derivative likhein
\[= \sec x\tan x + 4 \cdot \tfrac{1}{2}x^{-1/2} - 0\]
Kyun: \((\sec x)' = \sec x\tan x\) (Question 1(a)); power rule mein \(\frac{1}{2}\) aage aaya aur power \(\frac{1}{2} - 1 = -\frac{1}{2}\) ho gayi; 10 constant hai, us ka derivative 0.
Dhyan dein: constant ka derivative 0 hota hai, \(-10\) jawab mein nahi aata.

Simplify karein
\[= \sec x\tan x + 2x^{-1/2}\]
\[= \sec x\tan x + \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{x}}\]
Kyun: \(4 \times \frac{1}{2} = 2\), aur negative power ka matlab neeche jana: \(x^{-1/2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\).

Tasdeeq root wali term ki
\[x = 4:\ \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{4}} = 1\]
Kyun: \(x = 4\) par \(4\sqrt{x} = 8\) hai aur \(x = 4.1\) par taqreeban \(8.0998\). Yani \(x\) mein \(0.1\) barhne se taqreeban \(0.1\) ka izafa, matlab slope taqreeban 1. Hamara formula bhi 1 deta hai.
